verses.html: 1 Then Jesus began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a wine vat, and built a watchtower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
verses.text: 1 Then Jesus began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a wine vat, and built a watchtower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.

verses.html: 2 At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.text: 2 At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

verses.html: 3 But they seized the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.text: 3 But they seized the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.

verses.html: 4 Then he sent them another servant, and they struck him over the head and treated him shamefully.
verses.text: 4 Then he sent them another servant, and they struck him over the head and treated him shamefully.

verses.html: 5 He sent still another, and this one they killed. He sent many others; some they beat and others they killed.
verses.text: 5 He sent still another, and this one they killed. He sent many others; some they beat and others they killed.

verses.html: 6 Finally, having one beloved son, he sent him to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
verses.text: 6 Finally, having one beloved son, he sent him to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.

verses.html: 7 But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
verses.text: 7 But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

verses.html: 8 So they seized the son, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
verses.text: 8 So they seized the son, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.

verses.html: 9 What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.
verses.text: 9 What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.

verses.html: 10 Have you never read this Scripture: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
verses.text: 10 Have you never read this Scripture: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

verses.html: 11 This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
verses.text: 11 This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?”

verses.html: 12 At this, the leaders sought to arrest Jesus, for they knew that He had spoken this parable against them. But fearing the crowd, they left Him and went away.
verses.text: 12 At this, the leaders sought to arrest Jesus, for they knew that He had spoken this parable against them. But fearing the crowd, they left Him and went away.

verses.html: 1 And he began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard and put a hedge around it and dug a pit for a winepress and built a watchtower and rented it out to farmers and went abroad.
verses.text: 1 And he began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard and put a hedge around it and dug a pit for a winepress and built a watchtower and rented it out to farmers and went abroad.

verses.html: 2 And at the time he sent a servant to the farmers so that he might receive from the farmers from the fruits of the vineyard.
verses.text: 2 And at the time he sent a servant to the farmers so that he might receive from the farmers from the fruits of the vineyard.

verses.html: 3 And having seized him, they beat {him}, and sent {him} away empty.
verses.text: 3 And having seized him, they beat {him}, and sent {him} away empty.

verses.html: 4 And again he sent to them another servant, and that one they wounded in the head and treated shamefully.
verses.text: 4 And again he sent to them another servant, and that one they wounded in the head and treated shamefully.

verses.html: 5 And he sent another, and that one they killed, and many others—beating some and killing others.
verses.text: 5 And he sent another, and that one they killed, and many others—beating some and killing others.

verses.html: 6 Having one more, a beloved son, he sent him to them last, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.text: 6 Having one more, a beloved son, he sent him to them last, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

verses.html: 7 But those farmers said to each other, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
verses.text: 7 But those farmers said to each other, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

verses.html: 8 And having seized {him}, they killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
verses.text: 8 And having seized {him}, they killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.

verses.html: 9 What then will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers and will give the vineyard to others.
verses.text: 9 What then will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers and will give the vineyard to others.

verses.html: 10 And have you not read this scripture? ‘A stone that the builders rejected, this has become the head of the corner.
verses.text: 10 And have you not read this scripture? ‘A stone that the builders rejected, this has become the head of the corner.

verses.html: 11 This came about from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes.’”
verses.text: 11 This came about from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes.’”

verses.html: 12 And they were seeking to seize him, and they feared the crowd, for they knew that he spoke the parable against them. And having left him, they went away.
verses.text: 12 And they were seeking to seize him, and they feared the crowd, for they knew that he spoke the parable against them. And having left him, they went away.

verses.html: 1 Then Jesus started to tell a story to the ruling priests, the teachers of the Jewish law, and the other Jewish leaders. He said, “A certain man planted a vineyard. He built a fence around it {in order to protect it}. He made a stone tank {to collect the grape juice that they would press out of the grapes}. He also built a tower {for someone to sit in to guard his vineyard}. He rented the vineyard to some people who would take care of it, and he left to travel to a different country.
verses.text: 1 Then Jesus started to tell a story to the ruling priests, the teachers of the Jewish law, and the other Jewish leaders. He said, “A certain man planted a vineyard. He built a fence around it {in order to protect it}. He made a stone tank {to collect the grape juice that they would press out of the grapes}. He also built a tower {for someone to sit in to guard his vineyard}. He rented the vineyard to some people who would take care of it, and he left to travel to a different country.

verses.html: 2 When it was time {to harvest the grapes}, the man told one of his servants to go to the people who were taking care of the vineyard. He wanted them to give him his share of the grapes that the vineyard had produced.
verses.text: 2 When it was time {to harvest the grapes}, the man told one of his servants to go to the people who were taking care of the vineyard. He wanted them to give him his share of the grapes that the vineyard had produced.

verses.html: 3 However, the people who were taking care of the vineyard grabbed the man’s servant. They beat him up and told him to go away without giving him any of the grapes.
verses.text: 3 However, the people who were taking care of the vineyard grabbed the man’s servant. They beat him up and told him to go away without giving him any of the grapes.

verses.html: 4 After that, the man told another servant to go to the people who were taking care of the vineyard. However, they beat this servant on the head and insulted him.
verses.text: 4 After that, the man told another servant to go to the people who were taking care of the vineyard. However, they beat this servant on the head and insulted him.

verses.html: 5 After that, the man told another servant to go {to the people who were taking care of the vineyard}. However, they killed this servant. After that, the man sent many other servants. However, they beat up some of them and killed the others.
verses.text: 5 After that, the man told another servant to go {to the people who were taking care of the vineyard}. However, they killed this servant. After that, the man sent many other servants. However, they beat up some of them and killed the others.

verses.html: 6 Finally, the man still had only one other person with him, his son, whom he loved very much. So, the man told his son to go to them last of all. He thought that they would treat his son well {and give him his share of the grapes}.
verses.text: 6 Finally, the man still had only one other person with him, his son, whom he loved very much. So, the man told his son to go to them last of all. He thought that they would treat his son well {and give him his share of the grapes}.

verses.html: 7 However, {when} the people who were taking care of the vineyard {saw the man’s son arriving, they} told each other, ‘This man is the one who will inherit the vineyard. We should kill him, and then we can take the vineyard for ourselves.’
verses.text: 7 However, {when} the people who were taking care of the vineyard {saw the man’s son arriving, they} told each other, ‘This man is the one who will inherit the vineyard. We should kill him, and then we can take the vineyard for ourselves.’

verses.html: 8 So, they grabbed the man’s son and murdered him. Then, they dragged his corpse outside the vineyard.
verses.text: 8 So, they grabbed the man’s son and murdered him. Then, they dragged his corpse outside the vineyard.

verses.html: 9 I will tell you how the man who owned the vineyard will act. He will arrive {at the vineyard}, and he will kill the people who were taking care of the vineyard. Then, he will arrange for other people to take care of it.
verses.text: 9 I will tell you how the man who owned the vineyard will act. He will arrive {at the vineyard}, and he will kill the people who were taking care of the vineyard. Then, he will arrange for other people to take care of it.

verses.html: 10 {What I have said fits with} this scripture that you have read: ‘The people who were constructing a building refused to use a certain stone. However, that stone is now the most important one in the building.
verses.text: 10 {What I have said fits with} this scripture that you have read: ‘The people who were constructing a building refused to use a certain stone. However, that stone is now the most important one in the building.

verses.html: 11 The Lord {God} did that, and we think it is amazing.’”
verses.text: 11 The Lord {God} did that, and we think it is amazing.’”

verses.html: 12 Then the ruling priests, the teachers of the Jewish law, and the other Jewish leaders realized that Jesus was accusing them when he told that story. Because of that, they wanted to arrest him. However, they were afraid of how the large group of people would react. So, they left where he was {without arresting him}.
verses.text: 12 Then the ruling priests, the teachers of the Jewish law, and the other Jewish leaders realized that Jesus was accusing them when he told that story. Because of that, they wanted to arrest him. However, they were afraid of how the large group of people would react. So, they left where he was {without arresting him}.
